label: CKD review: Review Dilart HCT when CrCl is below 30 mL/min
title: Review Dilart HCT when CrCl is below 30 mL/min
statement: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review Dilart HCT when CrCl is below 30 mL/min.

plain_summary: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review Dilart HCT when CrCl is below 30 mL/min. Current use with confirmed CrCl below 30 mL/min is contraindicated and needs same-day review.

medicine_groups.name: Dilart HCT tablets
medicine_groups.note: Require the named fixed-dose product. The ingredients alone do not identify Dilart HCT.

rule_for_models: Check a named Dilart HCT fixed-dose supply in an adult outpatient. Report a finding and cite the supply, established CKD and dated stable unindexed creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min at supply. Report no finding for a different product, confirmed absence of CKD, or an applicable clearance of 30 mL/min or higher. If required information is missing or the clearance cannot be interpreted at supply, report only a possible finding naming what needs confirmation, including CKD, unindexed clearance or kidney stability. If age is unknown and the other evidence still allows this finding, report only a possible finding and ask whether the patient was at least 18 at supply. A known exclusion takes precedence over a missing fact.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish the dose taken. Kidney results obtained elsewhere, their units and their timing may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review Dilart HCT against the current unindexed creatinine clearance in mL/min and confirm whether kidney function was stable at supply?

needs_facts.meets: Established CKD at the time of outpatient supply.

options.words: CKD was established by the supply date
CKD was absent at the supply date
CKD is known now but its timing is unclear

needs_facts.meets: Use a dated, unindexed CrCl in mL/min applicable at supply. Below 30 meets the numerical condition. Verify the timing of an undated typed value and assess kidney stability separately.
